due_when.clears_when: action.yml declares a `records-file` input, threads it as `--records-file` into the `research_result.py --emit` call, and a dispatched m20-exit-lever-sweep.yml / research-exit-head-build.yml run is observed landing ONE ROW PER DISPATCHED LEG on main (not one generic row) — or this is found to already work some other way this session missed.

terminal_reason: Fixed and OBSERVED end-to-end 2026-09-26 (PR #13001, branch claude/fix-m20-sweep-empty-result): action.yml now declares `records-file` and threads it as `--records-file` into the emit step; added scripts/ci/check_action_input_wiring.py (run_guards.py: action-input-wiring) so an undeclared composite-action `with:` key fails CI instead of silently warning. Re-dispatched RQ-20260922-003 (run 36254494896) and RQ-20260922-004 (run 36254496707) via workflow_dispatch on main post-merge. Both landed ONE ROW PER DISPATCHED LEG with real computed verdicts, not the old placeholder: research/results/RQ-20260922-003/36254494896.jsonl reads verdict=pass, read_state=measured, n=49 (2 of 17 cells cleared RULE-M20-EXIT-LEVER-IS-OOS-GATE); research/results/RQ-20260922-004/36254496707.jsonl reads verdict=no_action_warranted, read_state=measured, n=49 (0 of 5 cells cleared). Landed via PR #13005 and #13004 respectively.
what: `.github/actions/research-result/action.yml` declares no `records-file` input, but m20-exit-lever-sweep.yml's `research_result` job (line ~941) passes `records-file: rr/records.jsonl` to it expecting per-leg records. GH Actions silently ignores an undeclared `with:` input, so `research_result.py --emit` runs WITHOUT --records-file and emits one generic record (`verdict: not_applicable`, `read-state: not_attempted`, `population: per-leg; see each record`, `n: null`) instead of one row per dispatched leg. MEASURED 2026-09-25 by reading action.yml's `inputs:` block (token, research-unit, power-state, decision-rule-id, decision-rule-registered-at, verdict, read-state, population, n, measurement-file, artifact-store, artifact-locator, rows-landed, tool, note, min-rows — no records-file) against scripts/research/research_result.py's `--records-file` CLI flag, which the action's `emit` step never passes through. Likely self-catching in practice (min-rows is set to the fan-out width, so a single generic row should fail assert_rows_landed's min-rows check) but not verified end-to-end — found while unblocking RQ-20260922-003/004/007 (W4), out of that lane's scope to fix (no src/ order-path changes, ceiling $12).
